property_summary: For any admissible funding total and value v (1 ≤ v ≤ total), a successful withdraw(v) pays the recipient (here the owner/caller) exactly v — the caller's balance rises by exactly _value — while the mutant pays out the entire contract balance instead, so for v < total the caller receives more than v.
change_summary: Transfer the entire contract balance instead of the requested _value.
